wizard.title: Initial Setup Guide
wizard.subtitle: Essential settings to get started with Grosoq
wizard.welcomeDesc1: Grosoq uses Groq's ultra-fast AI to instantly analyze MK8DX and Mario Kart World race results.
wizard.welcomeDesc2: Let's complete two quick settings to get started.
wizard.step1Desc: Enter the Groq API key used for analysis. It's free to obtain.
wizard.how2: Create and copy a key via "Create API Key"
wizard.how3: Paste it into the field above
wizard.calDesc: For 24-player standings mode: mark the region containing names and scores. Anything outside (badges/stickers) is excluded from analysis. Capture a preview, adjust the frames, and save.
wizard.calNote: * This step applies to "24-player standings" mode only. You can skip it for standard mode. You can also change these settings later in Settings.
wizard.step2Desc: Connect to OBS to capture the game screen.
wizard.passwordHint: * If you haven't set a password in OBS's WebSocket server settings, leave this field empty.
wizard.sourcePlaceholder: Enter capture source name or run connection test
wizard.sourceHint: * After a successful connection test, the list of sources in OBS is fetched automatically.
wizard.readyDesc: All settings are complete. Experience Grosoq's ultra-fast analysis now.

config.title: Settings
config.obsPasswordHint: * If you haven't set a password in OBS's WebSocket server settings, leave this field empty.
config.obsSourceDropdownHint: * Connect to OBS to select from list
config.modelsVisionNo: Likely does not support image input
config.modelsNeedKey: Enter and save your Groq API key to load the model list.
config.modelsHint: * Vision support is estimated from model IDs. Check Groq's documentation for the latest availability.
config.analysisModeStandardHelp: Calculates points from the rank on the results screen and adds them
config.analysisModeStandingsHelp: Reads cumulative scores directly from the pre-race standings screen
config.analysisModeHelp: * Standings mode analyzes only the left half of the capture and overwrites current scores with the read values. Make sure the correct screen is being captured.
config.calHint: Enclose only the region containing names and scores. Anything outside (badges/stickers) is excluded from analysis. Values are % of full capture width/height.
config.obsDefaultsHint: * Unless you have a specific reason to change them, the default OBS IP (127.0.0.1) and port (4455) work as-is.
config.calRegionHint12: 12P: On the results screen, select the range where all players' names and scores (1st-12th) are visible.
config.calRegionHint24: 24P: On the pre-race standings screen, select the range where names and scores are listed vertically, 12 players per column (2 columns).
config.calPresetSelectSaved: View and edit the saved calibration values
config.calPresetSelectNew: Not saved yet — creates a new preset from the current values
config.calPresetsHint: There are 3 fixed presets: MK8DX, MK World 12P, and MK World 24P (● = saved). Click a chip to switch which preset you are editing; edits are saved automatically. The preset marked "← Analyzing:" is the one actually used for the current analysis mode / game.
config.validationError: OBS settings and Groq API key are required

raceTracker.estimatedHint: Estimated from total points — disconnected players or missing data may affect accuracy

overlaySettings.scoreEffectColorHelp: Customize the color of the flash effect when team scores increase

settingsAi.title: AI Analysis (Groq)
settingsAi.qwenNote: * Currently uses Groq (Qwen 3.6 27B) — ultra-fast and free.
settingsAi.howToTitle: How to get a Groq API key
settingsAi.how2: Sign up / log in with a Google account or email address.
settingsAi.how4: Name it (e.g., MK8DX), create it, and copy the code (gsk_...) into the field above.

overlayUi.keepScoresHelp: When turned off, scores are reset automatically each time the app starts
overlayUi.remainingRacesHelp: Shows the remaining race count next to the 1st place team
overlayUi.urlDesc: Set this URL as the browser source in OBS
overlayUi.themeDesc: Changes the overall design style of the overlay.
overlayUi.scoreEffectDesc: Changes the glow color when points are added.
overlayUi.ownTeamStyleDesc: Border style for your own (or selected) team.
overlayUi.rankAnimHelp: Enables the slide animation when ranks change
overlayUi.flashHelp: Highlights the team box with a glow when points are added

usage.title: How to Use
usage.steps:
1. Enter and save the settings above
2. Click 'Open Overlay' to open browser
3. Set that URL as OBS browser source
4. Click 'Fetch Race Results' button on the race result screen
